About Simone On Sunset

Located at 2418 Sunset Blvd in Houston, Texas, Simone On Sunset is an upscale dining and event venue offering a perfect blend of sophistication and casual charm. Whether you're looking for a cozy date spot or a place to host a memorable event, this lounge offers a unique atmosphere with a small, intimate patio that adds to its cozy allure.

The restaurant’s menu features a variety of exceptional specialty pizzas, with some standout options like the Tonno e Cipolla pizza, which incorporates tuna-a delightful twist for pizza lovers looking to explore new flavors. For a lighter bite, their shareable plates are perfect for group gatherings, offering a chance to sample a variety of creative dishes. One crowd favorite includes the Tandoori Scallops, a perfect fusion of Asian and Italian influences, adding a unique flair to the menu.

Simone On Sunset is particularly known for its impeccable service, where staff ensure every visit is a seamless and enjoyable experience. Their drinks menu is another highlight, featuring expertly crafted cocktails like the Espresso Martini, loved by many for its rich flavor, and Old Fashioneds that add a classic touch to the evening. Although the espresso martini is a bit on the pricier side, the quality of the drinks and the overall experience makes it a worthwhile indulgence.

The venue's atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between modern sophistication and comfort, making it an ideal choice for a date night or a casual night out. The complimentary valet service ensures convenience for guests, offering a stress-free start to your evening.

With its remarkable food, drinks, and ambiance, Simone On Sunset has earned a reputation as one of Houston's top dining destinations. Whether you're visiting for a romantic evening or enjoying a casual gathering with friends, this spot promises an unforgettable experience.

Reviews

“ Extremely cool place. Would definitely come again. Everyone else was amazing. The manager was great the Barback was even attentive asking if we needed anything. ”

J O N

“ Gorgeous little bar with a great atmosphere. Loved their customer service. We ordered chicken lollipops and the smoke duck pizza. Food was delicious. I truly recommend this place ”

Elizabeth Cadena

“ As someone who has been here several time I highly recommend. I have a niche drink order they have the bar to cater to it. Furthermore, they have a good selection of food and amazing service. It also has dance nights through the week of you are a beginner or an expert. Highly recommend on all accounts. ”

Maria

“ Very welcoming entrance and the ambience was relaxing with tasteful decor. We ordered food tapas style and loved everything we ate. Chicken lollipops and truffle popcorn are to die for . The owner, Eddie, did an amazing job blending different flavors and adding diversity to the food options. They also serve a variety of drinks and interesting cocktails. There are several options for a coffee martini and they were delish! ”

Katrina Ta

“ This is when my favorite regular Hangouts and makes a terrific date spot. The old fashions and espresso martinis are to die for and the service is always impeccable. I recommend trying one of their pizzas for shared food. I literally cannot think of a time that I had a bad experience here. 10/10 recommend. ”

Garrett Hart

“ Absolutely loved our experience at Simone on Sunset! The patio vibes were just perfect for a relaxed evening. We tried the Capri and Smoked Duck pizzas, and wow, they were delicious! Great spot for a casual hangout with fantastic food. Will definitely be back for more. ”

Sadie Sanders

“ Tonno e Cipolla pizza is really good. Haven’t tried pizza with tuna before and it was definitely pleasing and will want to try again. Margherita pizza was half off for ladies on Wednesday night so it was 7 and was pretty good but not so special. Espresso Martini was a bit too strong for me and a bit pricey (18). I don’t think I’ll order the espresso martini again because it was just too expensive compared to other espresso martinis. Tandoori Scallops were pretty delicious as well. It was like an Asian, Italian fusion food and was surprisingly good as well. Vibe of the restaurant is interesting... not my style of vibe but it was okay. I’d give a detail rating of 4.2 for this place. Also valet parking was complimentary but pls do add tip for these guys :) ”

Angelina Choi

“ Upscale dinner date lounge and event space with a small intimate patio. Great speciality pizzas and shareables. ”

Bryan Mikicich

Simone On Sunset

Simone On Sunset offers a trendy and cozy setting in Houston, TX, with great beer, cocktails, and a fantastic wine list. Enjoy live music, sport viewing, and delicious food including truffle parmesan popcorn and signature burgers. With a welcoming LGBTQ+ friendly environment, Simone On Sunset is perfect for solo dining, group gatherings, and special occasions. Don't miss out on their cheese and charcuterie boards for the perfect sharing experience. Make a reservation today and experience the impeccable service and delightful ambiance at Simone On Sunset.
